en.heroIntro: I am Yiran Rex Ma — artist, engineer, human. I am a master's student in Foreign Linguistics and Applied Linguistics at Peking University, now working as an independent researcher and entrepreneur. I am striding towards becoming an LLM engineer, focusing on continual learning and personal models that swiftly adapt the foundation to diverse domains and align with inherent human preferences.

zh.heroIntro: 我是马义然（Yiran Rex Ma）——artist, engineer, human。我是北京大学外国语言学及应用语言学硕士研究生，现为独立研究者与创业者。我正努力成为一名 LLM 工程师，关注持续学习与个人模型：让基础模型快速适配多样的垂直领域，并实现对人类内在偏好的真正对齐。
